headline: IMFA releases scrutinizer report on postal ballot voting
hook: Postal ballot results finalized for IMFA

modes.bear: Depending on the resolutions passed, some shareholders may face dilution or unfavorable governance changes.
modes.bull: Shareholder approval of company proposals suggests alignment between management and investors on strategic direction.
modes.simple: The company held a vote for its shareholders to decide on specific business matters. This report confirms how those votes went and officially records the results.

summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has submitted its official scrutinizer's report following a postal ballot process. The company has also disclosed the final voting results to the National Stock Exchange. This filing confirms the completion of the shareholder decision-making process for the items proposed in the ballot.
why_it_matters: Formalizes shareholder approval for company resolutions.

headline: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys completes postal ballot proceedings
hook: Shareholders conclude postal ballot voting process

modes.bear: The lack of specific resolution details leaves uncertainty regarding potential changes in company policy or management direction.
modes.bull: Successful completion of the ballot process indicates standard corporate governance and progress on pending shareholder resolutions.
modes.simple: The company has finished a remote voting process for its shareholders. The results of these votes will be shared soon, which could provide clarity on the company's future plans.

summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has officially informed the NSE regarding the conclusion of its postal ballot process. This procedure allows shareholders to vote on company resolutions without attending a physical meeting. The company will now proceed to announce the results of the voting as per regulatory requirements. Retail investors should note that the outcome of these resolutions may impact corporate governance or strategic decisions.
whats_next: Announcement of postal ballot voting results
why_it_matters: Upcoming resolution results may influence company strategy or governance.

headline: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys posts 51% jump in Q2 profit, declares interim dividend
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys reported a 51.4% year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹147.76 crore for the September quarter, though profit fell 23.3% sequentially. Revenue increased 34.7% annually to support the earnings growth. Alongside the financial results, the company declared an interim dividend of ₹5 per share. Following the announcement, the company's shares rose 2.5% to trade at ₹1,126.
why_it_matters: IMFA shareholders receive a ₹5 dividend alongside higher annual earnings.

headline: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys announces an acquisition
hook: Routine corporate filing from Indian Metals
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has formally informed the stock exchange about an acquisition. No further financial details, transaction value, or target company specifics were provided in the exchange filing. For retail investors holding the stock, corporate disclosures without accompanying deal size or valuation make it difficult to assess immediate financial impact.
whats_next: Detailed exchange disclosure regarding acquisition targets and financials
why_it_matters: Deal details awaited before assessing value impact

headline: IMFA sets November 12, 2026 as dividend record date
hook: Record date set for latest dividend
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has notified the stock exchanges that November 12, 2026, will serve as the record date for an upcoming dividend payout. Shareholders holding the company's shares on this date will be eligible to receive the declared dividend. This routine corporate action affects existing investors by determining dividend entitlement. Retail shareholders holding IMFA stock should note this date to ensure their holdings qualify for the payout.
why_it_matters: Hold shares by record date to claim dividend payout

headline: IMFA board declares interim dividend of Rs 5 per share
hook: Third interim payout this year for shareholders
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 5 per equity share following its board meeting on November 4, 2026. The distribution rewards current shareholders with a direct cash payout. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this provides a steady cash flow return independent of market price movements.
whats_next: Record date for dividend eligibility to be announced
why_it_matters: Rs 5 per share cash hits your account soon

headline: IMFA allots equity shares in JSW Renew Energy Twelve Limited
hook: Strategic stake expansion in renewable energy
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has announced the allotment of equity shares in JSW Renew Energy Twelve Limited. The regulatory filing provides details of this corporate investment but lacks financial figures and shareholding percentages. Indian retail investors holding IMFA should note this move toward renewable energy integration. The development reflects corporate participation in green energy infrastructure.
why_it_matters: Green energy investments shape long-term power costs for industrial firms.
